Script.name: TAP_Client
Script.script:
TAP = TAP or {}
local profile = getProfileName() TAP.profile = profile TAP.where_name = "TAP_Where_" .. profile TAP.where_console_name = "TAP_Where_Console_" .. profile TAP.comm_name = "TAP_Comm_" .. profile TAP.comm_local_name = "TAP_Comm_Local_" .. profile TAP.comm_ooc_name = "TAP_Comm_OOC_" .. profile TAP.comm_mudinfo_name = "TAP_Comm_MudInfo_" .. profile TAP.comm_tab_local_name = "TAP_TabLocal_" .. profile TAP.comm_tab_ooc_name = "TAP_TabOOC_" .. profile TAP.comm_tab_mudinfo_name = "TAP_TabMudInfo_" .. profile TAP.prompt_name = "TAP_Prompt_" .. profile TAP.prompt_console_name = "TAP_Prompt_Console_" .. profile
TAP.package_url = "http://theabyssalplane.duckdns.org/static/mudlet/theabyssalplanes.mpackage" TAP.settings_file = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/TAP_settings.lua"
TAP.target_keys = { map = "map", comm = "comm", communication = "comm", status = "status" }
TAP.settings = { fonts = {}, visible = { map = true, comm = true, status = true } }
if not TAP.where_win then TAP.where_win = Geyser.UserWindow:new({ name = TAP.where_name, titleText = "Map", docked = true, dockPosition = "right", width = 300, height = 300 }) TAP.where_console = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = TAP.where_console_name, x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = "100%", autoWrap = true, fontSize = 10, color = "black" }, TAP.where_win) end
if not TAP.prompt_win then setBorderBottom(20) local w, h = getMainWindowSize() createMiniConsole(TAP.prompt_console_name, 0, h - 20, w, 20) setFont(TAP.prompt_console_name, getFont("main")) setFontSize(TAP.prompt_console_name, getFontSize("main")) setBackgroundColor(TAP.prompt_console_name, 0, 0, 0, 255) setWindowWrap(TAP.prompt_console_name, 200) end
if not TAP.comm_win then TAP.comm_win = Geyser.UserWindow:new({ name = TAP.comm_name, titleText = "Communication", docked = true, dockPosition = "right", width = 300, height = 400 }) TAP.comm_tab_local = Geyser.Label:new({ name = TAP.comm_tab_local_name, x = 0, y = 0, width = "33%", height = 25, text = " Local ", fontSize = 10, color = "gray" }, TAP.comm_win) TAP.comm_tab_ooc = Geyser.Label:new({ name = TAP.comm_tab_ooc_name, x = "33%", y = 0, width = "34%", height = 25, text = " OOC ", fontSize = 10, color = "gray" }, TAP.comm_win) TAP.comm_tab_mudinfo = Geyser.Label:new({ name = TAP.comm_tab_mudinfo_name, x = "67%", y = 0, width = "33%", height = 25, text = " MudInfo ", fontSize = 10, color = "gray" }, TAP.comm_win) TAP.comm_local = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = TAP.comm_local_name, x = 0, y = 25, width = "100%", height = "100%-25", autoWrap = true, fontSize = 10, color = "black" }, TAP.comm_win) TAP.comm_ooc = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = TAP.comm_ooc_name, x = 0, y = 25, width = "100%", height = "100%-25", autoWrap = true, fontSize = 10, color = "black" }, TAP.comm_win) TAP.comm_mudinfo = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = TAP.comm_mudinfo_name, x = 0, y = 25, width = "100%", height = "100%-25", autoWrap = true, fontSize = 10, color = "black" }, TAP.comm_win) TAP.comm_ooc:hide() TAP.comm_mudinfo:hide() TAP.comm_tab_ooc:echo(" OOC ") TAP.comm_tab_mudinfo:echo(" MudInfo ") TAP.comm_tab_local:echo(" Local ") end
function TAP.showTab(tab) if tab == "local" then TAP.comm_local:show() TAP.comm_ooc:hide() TAP.comm_mudinfo:hide() TAP.comm_tab_local:setColor("gray") TAP.comm_tab_ooc:setColor("dimGray") TAP.comm_tab_mudinfo:setColor("dimGray") elseif tab == "ooc" then TAP.comm_local:hide() TAP.comm_ooc:show() TAP.comm_mudinfo:hide() TAP.comm_tab_local:setColor("dimGray") TAP.comm_tab_ooc:setColor("gray") TAP.comm_tab_mudinfo:setColor("dimGray") elseif tab == "mudinfo" then TAP.comm_local:hide() TAP.comm_ooc:hide() TAP.comm_mudinfo:show() TAP.comm_tab_local:setColor("dimGray") TAP.comm_tab_ooc:setColor("dimGray") TAP.comm_tab_mudinfo:setColor("gray") end end
TAP.comm_tab_local:setClickCallback(function() TAP.showTab("local") end) TAP.comm_tab_ooc:setClickCallback(function() TAP.showTab("ooc") end) TAP.comm_tab_mudinfo:setClickCallback(function() TAP.showTab("mudinfo") end)
function TAP.copyToLocal() selectCaptureGroup(1) copy() appendBuffer(TAP.comm_local_name) end
function TAP.copyToOOC() selectCaptureGroup(1) copy() appendBuffer(TAP.comm_ooc_name) end
function TAP.copyToMudInfo() selectCaptureGroup(1) copy() appendBuffer(TAP.comm_mudinfo_name) end
function TAP.capturePrompt() clearWindow(TAP.prompt_console_name) selectCurrentLine() copy() appendBuffer(TAP.prompt_console_name) deleteLine() end
if TAP.trigger_ids then for _, id in ipairs(TAP.trigger_ids) do killTrigger(id) end end TAP.trigger_ids = {} TAP.trigger_ids[#TAP.trigger_ids + 1] = tempRegexTrigger("^\\[OOC\\].*", "TAP.copyToOOC()") TAP.trigger_ids[#TAP.trigger_ids + 1] = tempRegexTrigger("^\\[MudInfo\\].*", "TAP.copyToMudInfo()") TAP.trigger_ids[#TAP.trigger_ids + 1] = tempRegexTrigger(".*says?,.*", "TAP.copyToLocal()") TAP.trigger_ids[#TAP.trigger_ids + 1] = tempRegexTrigger("^\\s*.*\\[(physical|visarial).*\\]\\s*$", "TAP.capturePrompt()")
function TAP.handleTabSwitch(event, hasFocus) if hasFocus then if TAP.where_win and TAP.settings.visible.map then TAP.where_win:show() end if TAP.comm_win and TAP.settings.visible.comm then TAP.comm_win:show() end else if TAP.where_win then TAP.where_win:hide() end if TAP.comm_win then TAP.comm_win:hide() end end end
registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysProfileFocusChangeEvent", "TAP.handleTabSwitch")
function TAP.saveSettings() table.save(TAP.settings_file, TAP.settings) end
function TAP.loadSettings() if io.exists(TAP.settings_file) then table.load(TAP.settings_file, TAP.settings) end if TAP.settings.visible.map == nil then TAP.settings.visible.map = true end if TAP.settings.visible.comm == nil then TAP.settings.visible.comm = true end if TAP.settings.visible.status == nil then TAP.settings.visible.status = true end end
function TAP.consolesFor(target) if target == "map" then return { TAP.where_console } elseif target == "comm" then return { TAP.comm_local, TAP.comm_ooc, TAP.comm_mudinfo } end return nil end
function TAP.applyFont(target) local s = TAP.settings.fonts[target] if target == "status" then setFont(TAP.prompt_console_name, (s and s.name) or getFont("main")) setFontSize(TAP.prompt_console_name, (s and s.size) or getFontSize("main")) return end local consoles = TAP.consolesFor(target) if not consoles then return end for _, con in ipairs(consoles) do con:setFont((s and s.name) or getFont("main")) con:setFontSize((s and s.size) or getFontSize("main")) end end
function TAP.setVisible(target, onoff) TAP.settings.visible[target] = onoff if target == "status" then if onoff then showWindow(TAP.prompt_console_name) setBorderBottom(20) else hideWindow(TAP.prompt_console_name) setBorderBottom(0) end elseif target == "map" then if onoff then TAP.where_win:show() else TAP.where_win:hide() end elseif target == "comm" then if onoff then TAP.comm_win:show() else TAP.comm_win:hide() end end TAP.saveSettings() end
function TAP.applyVisibility() TAP.setVisible("map", TAP.settings.visible.map) TAP.setVisible("comm", TAP.settings.visible.comm) TAP.setVisible("status", TAP.settings.visible.status) end
function TAP.syncFont() TAP.applyFont("map") TAP.applyFont("comm") TAP.applyFont("status") end
function TAP.help() cecho([[<cyan>TAP: The Abyssal Planes UI package<reset>
<green>TAP help<reset> - show this help <green>TAP reset<reset> - rebuild all TAP windows (use after resizing your screen) <green>TAP fontsize map|communication|status <size><reset> - set font size for a console <green>TAP font map|communication|status <fontname><reset> - set font for a console <green>TAP map|communication|status on|off<reset> - show or hide a window <green>TAP update<reset> - download and install the latest package, then reload
'communication' changes all three chat tabs at once. Your font, size and window choices are saved automatically and restored on every load. ]]) end
function TAP.resetUI() resetProfile() end
function TAP.update() cecho("<cyan>TAP: Downloading latest package...\n") local ok, err = installPackage(TAP.package_url) if ok == false or (ok == nil and err ~= nil) then cecho("<red>TAP: Update failed: " .. tostring(err or "unknown error") .. "\n") return end cecho("<cyan>TAP: Package installed. Resetting profile...\n") tempTimer(0.5, function() resetProfile() end) end
function TAP.resolveTarget(word) word = word:lower() local target = TAP.target_keys[word] if not target then cecho("<red>TAP: Unknown window '" .. word .. "'. Use map, communication or status.\n") end return target end
function TAP.cmdFontSize(rest) local word, num = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+(%d+)%s*$") if not word then cecho("<red>Usage: TAP fontsize map|communication|status <size>\n") return end local target = TAP.resolveTarget(word) if not target then return end local size = tonumber(num) if size < 4 or size > 40 then cecho("<red>TAP: Size must be between 4 and 40.\n") return end TAP.settings.fonts[target] = TAP.settings.fonts[target] or {} TAP.settings.fonts[target].size = size TAP.applyFont(target) TAP.saveSettings() cecho("<green>TAP: " .. word:lower() .. " font size set to " .. size .. ".\n") end
function TAP.cmdFont(rest) local word, name = rest:match("^(%S+)%s+(.+)$") if not word then cecho("<red>Usage: TAP font map|communication|status <fontname>\n") return end local target = TAP.resolveTarget(word) if not target then return end local available = getAvailableFonts() local canonical for _, fname in ipairs(available) do if fname:lower() == name:lower() then canonical = fname break end end if not canonical then cecho("<red>TAP: Font '" .. name .. "' not found on this system.\n") return end TAP.settings.fonts[target] = TAP.settings.fonts[target] or {} TAP.settings.fonts[target].name = canonical TAP.applyFont(target) TAP.saveSettings() cecho("<green>TAP: " .. word:lower() .. " font set to " .. canonical .. ".\n") end
function TAP.command() local args = matches[2] if not args or args:trim() == "" then return TAP.help() end local cmd, rest = args:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") cmd = cmd:lower() if cmd == "help" then return TAP.help() elseif cmd == "reset" then return TAP.resetUI() elseif cmd == "update" then return TAP.update() elseif cmd == "fontsize" then return TAP.cmdFontSize(rest) elseif cmd == "font" then return TAP.cmdFont(rest) end local target = TAP.target_keys[cmd] if target then local onoff = rest:trim():lower() if onoff == "on" then TAP.setVisible(target, true) cecho("<green>TAP: " .. cmd:lower() .. " shown.\n") return elseif onoff == "off" then TAP.setVisible(target, false) cecho("<green>TAP: " .. cmd:lower() .. " hidden.\n") return else cecho("<red>Usage: TAP " .. cmd:lower() .. " on|off\n") return end end cecho("<red>TAP: Unknown command '" .. cmd .. "'. Type 'TAP help' for a list.\n") end
TAP.loadSettings() TAP.syncFont() TAP.applyVisibility()
loadWindowLayout()
function TAP.onExit() if hasFocus() ~= false then saveWindowLayout() end TAP.saveSettings() end
registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysExitEvent", "TAP.onExit")
cecho("<green>TAP: Loaded. Type 'TAP help' for options.\n")

Trigger.name: TAP_Map_Bottom
Trigger.script: local topLine = TAP.mapTopLine if topLine then local bottomLine = getLineNumber() clearWindow(TAP.where_console_name) for i = topLine, bottomLine do moveCursor("main", 1, i) selectCurrentLine() copy() appendBuffer(TAP.where_console_name) end if TAP.where_win then for i = bottomLine, topLine, -1 do moveCursor("main", 1, i) deleteLine() end end TAP.mapTopLine = nil end
